Serialize raw row-level loss sums and covered counts and a paired 2000-draw source-document-cluster bootstrap.
Publish the result create-only and atomically; preserve failures separately.
Use unrounded estimands for every decision and serialize an explicit conjunction of all four registered predicates; the completion status itself remains outcome-neutral.
